usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all resources currently managed by the Proxmox HA manager; each entry's `sid` (service ID) is the handle used by all other HA resource operations such as get, update, migrate, and delete. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/` — a cluster-level privilege, so API tokens scoped to a single node or resource will be denied. Filter by `type` (`vm` or `ct`) to narrow results when working with a mixed cluster.
tips: The returned `sid` format is `<type>:<vmid>` (e.g. `vm:100`, `ct:201`); use it verbatim as the path segment when calling per-resource HA endpoints.
A resource appearing here does not guarantee it is currently running — check `state` and `crm_state` fields on the individual resource detail endpoint.
HA resources are cluster-wide config; this endpoint is valid against any cluster node, not just the primary.
